items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I studied a little bit with Stanley, not that long.

ctx.x: Stanley was around Boston, yeah. He eventually moved to New York. I studied a little bit with Stanley, not that long. He got my reading — sort of got my reading up a little bit, which I never bother with. You can’t see the notes, what the hell’s the use of reading? You still have to play by ear and I hate playing with big bands anymore, they’re just over-written. You know the arrangers have taken everything — it’s like watching a movie where the cameraman is now the director, you know? What the hell kind of a…
Well we were talking about actually how you got started with big bands, but Woody Herman was your first big band?
